state_order: The 16 hexadecimal nibbles are in row-major order. Position 4*r+c is row r, column c. Round, position and bit indices are zero based.
nibble_bit_order: Within each nibble, bit 0 is the least significant bit.
round_function: Apply the S-box independently to all 16 nibbles.
For round constant rc, XOR rc&0xf into state[0,0], (rc>>4)&0x3 into state[1,0], and 0x2 into state[2,0].
XOR the first two rows of the current round-key state into the first two state rows.
For each column with ShiftRows output (x0,x1,x2,x3), MixColumns returns (x0 xor x2 xor x3, x0, x1 xor x2, x0 xor x2).

key_schedule.master_key: A 4x4 row-major array K[0]..K[15] of hexadecimal nibbles.
key_schedule.round_key: Round r uses the first two rows of the current key state.
key_schedule.permutation_semantics: After each round, next_key[i] = current_key[permutation[i]]. No LFSR is applied.

probability_semantics: For a fixed master key K, sample the 64-bit first plaintext uniformly and pair it with plaintext xor the round-0 input difference. The fixed-key probability is the fraction of first plaintexts for which every S-box has exactly the input/output difference fixed in the trail attachment. The expected differential probability additionally averages this fixed-key probability over all 64-bit master keys.
